What Are Non GamStop Casinos?

Non-GamStop casinos are online gambling platforms that operate outside the UK Gambling Commission’s (UKGC) regulations and are not linked to the GamStop self-exclusion scheme. When players register with GamStop, they cannot access any UKGC-licensed sites during their exclusion period. However, this self-exclusion does not extend to casinos operating under international licenses, which is where non-GamStop casinos come in.

These casinos operate under licenses from jurisdictions such as Curacao or Malta, which means they are not subject to the same restrictions and regulations as UKGC-licensed casinos. As a result, players can freely access these platforms, even if they have registered with GamStop. Non-GamStop casinos are appealing to players for several reasons, including the availability of higher betting limits, a broader selection of games, and enticing bonuses that may not be available at UK-regulated sites.

What to Watch Out For

While the bonuses at non-GamStop casinos can be enticing, players should be aware of the potential pitfalls associated with them. Here are some aspects to consider:

  • Wagering Requirements: These requirements dictate how many times players must wager the bonus amount before they can withdraw winnings. Common wagering rates range from x30 to x50, meaning a £100 bonus may require players to wager £3,000 to £5,000 before cashing out.
  • Game Weighting: Different games contribute differently towards meeting wagering requirements. Slots typically contribute 100%, while table games may contribute less.
  • Maximum Bet Rules: Some casinos impose limits on how much players can bet while playing with bonus funds, which can affect strategies.
  • Time Limits: Bonuses often come with expiration dates. Players must complete the wagering requirements within the specified timeframe to keep their winnings.
  • Maximum Withdrawal Limits: There may be caps on how much players can withdraw from winnings generated through bonus funds.
  • Sticky vs Non-Sticky Bonuses: Sticky bonuses cannot be withdrawn, while non-sticky bonuses allow players to withdraw their deposit at any time. Understanding the difference is crucial.

By being aware of these factors, players can make informed decisions and maximise their experience at non-GamStop casinos UK.
